summary: Tested 3 new features: (1) Import validation for TIFMAS/EMTF Rank pages, (2) Import History cleanup via new DELETE endpoint, (3) Deployment Roster PDF/Excel export in Reports. Backend DELETE endpoint 4/4 pytest PASS. Frontend: validation warnings for duplicate/already-exists/invalid-bool/invalid-pack-test WORK; Clear History dialog WORKS end-to-end (all 5 period options; deletion succeeds); Excel export WORKS (35KB xlsx w/ Summary + Roster sheets). CRITICAL BUG FOUND: PDF export throws 'doc.autoTable is not a function' due to jspdf-autotable v5 API change. Secondary bug: parseCSV silently drops rows with empty name, so the 'missing name' ERROR path is unreachable and Import button is never disabled by validation errors.

ui_bugs.issue: PDF export fails with runtime error 'TypeError: doc.autoTable is not a function'. jspdf-autotable v5.x (package.json: ^5.0.8) no longer augments the jsPDF prototype; the plugin now exports autoTable as a named function. Import 'jspdf-autotable' side-effect no longer attaches doc.autoTable in v5. Fix: `import autoTable from 'jspdf-autotable';` then call `autoTable(doc, { startY: 75, head: [...], body: tableData, ... });` instead of `doc.autoTable({...})`. Affects line 896 of /app/frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.js.

parseCSV (line 335) filters out any row where `row.name` is falsy: `if (row.name) { data.push(row); }`. Because empty-name rows never reach validateImportData, the 'Row X: Missing required field name' ERROR is unreachable. Consequently, the Import button's `disabled={importing || importValidation.errors.length > 0}` guard is never triggered by missing names, contradicting requirement: 'Import validation should show errors for missing name fields in CSV' and 'Import button should be disabled if there are validation errors'. Fix: push all rows to `data` in parseCSV (drop the `if (row.name)` gate) and let validateImportData surface the error.

action_items: HIGH: Fix PDF export in /app/frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.js: change `import 'jspdf-autotable'` to `import autoTable from 'jspdf-autotable'` and replace `doc.autoTable({...})` with `autoTable(doc, {...})` (jspdf-autotable v5 API). Apply same fix anywhere else doc.autoTable is used.

HIGH: Fix parseCSV in TIFMASRankPage.js and EMTFRankPage.js (line ~335): remove the `if (row.name)` gate so rows with missing name reach validateImportData; the validator will emit the missing-name error and disable the Import button. Verify Import button becomes disabled when errors exist and label shows 'Fix Errors First'.
critical_code_review_comments: jspdf-autotable v5 breaking change not addressed: prototype patching was removed; code still uses `doc.autoTable(...)`. Add a smoke test that renders and downloads the PDF as part of CI.

parseCSV double-validates 'name': it drops empty-name rows AND validateImportData tries to error on them. Pick one place; keeping validation in validateImportData is preferable so the UI can show errors and disable Import.

TIFMASRankPage.js and EMTFRankPage.js share ~identical validate/import/history/cleanup logic. This is a substantial DRY violation (>50 lines duplicated). Extract into a shared hook (e.g. useRosterImport) or module.

Clear History dialog uses generic button text 'Clear History' both for the toolbar trigger and the destructive confirm inside the dialog. Consider adding data-testid='clear-history-btn' (trigger) and data-testid='clear-history-confirm-btn' (confirm) to disambiguate for tests.

handleExportPdf's logo load path uses try/catch around a Promise with img.onerror = reject, and continues on failure - good. But `img.crossOrigin='Anonymous'` combined with a same-origin path is unnecessary and may cause tainted-canvas issues if LOGO_URL is ever swapped to a CDN.

backend DELETE /api/deployment-roster/import-history: `older_than_days` accepts 0=all; consider validating negative values (currently silently treated same as 0). Also compares `created_at` as ISO string via $lt which works only because created_at is stored as ISO string; add an index on (tenant_id, created_at) for scale.

Then click Export -> Export to PDF on a generated Deployment Roster Export report and verify a valid PDF (%PDF- header) downloads. Excel export and DELETE endpoint are already fully green.
rca of the issue: PDF: jspdf-autotable ^5.0.8 removed automatic jsPDF.prototype.autoTable augmentation from side-effect import in v5; must import autoTable as named default and call as function - see https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable v5 migration. Missing-name validation: parseCSV in TIFMAS/EMTFRankPage discards rows where name is empty (`if (row.name) data.push(row)`), so validateImportData never sees them and its error branch is dead code, leaving the Import button always enabled regardless of missing names.
